country-selector.purpose: Let users choose one country and calling-code context with visible flag support, text label, code, option layer, keyboard selection, and inline composition for Phone Input.
country-selector.referenceRationale: The ZIP includes SelectCountry. Flow keeps the country/calling-code selector as its own component and lets Phone Input consume it.

anatomy.rule: Shows selected flag, calling code, and chevron.
Decorative country recognition; text remains required.
Lists country label and calling code with selected state.
Composes inside Phone Input without transferring ownership.

variants.description: Compact selector composed inside another field.

Energy.decision: Use semantic selected, focus, error, disabled, and option colors.
Energy.behavior: Country state is visible without raw colors.

Voice.decision: Use country label, calling code, and option text.

Frame.decision: Use Select trigger and option layer rhythm.
Frame.behavior: Inline mode fits Phone Input without clipping.

Depth.decision: Use option-layer depth only when open.

Momentum.decision: Use Select chevron and option-layer motion.
Momentum.behavior: Chevron and listbox follow shared motion.

State.decision: Resolve disabled, error, open, focus, and default states.

Tone.decision: Use neutral country labels; error tone comes from parent validation.
Tone.behavior: Country selection does not introduce false urgency.

Growth.decision: Compose into Phone Input and other flows without duplicating implementation.
Growth.behavior: Country logic scales from one owner.

Symbol.decision: Treat flags and chevron as symbols that support text.

Iconography.decision: Use flag primitive and shared chevron sizing.

Accessibility.decision: Expose combobox/listbox semantics and keyboard selection.
Accessibility.behavior: Keyboard users can open, move, select, and recover focus.

props.name: id
props.notes: Stable id used to connect trigger and listbox.

props.name: country
props.notes: Alias for selected country code when composed by another field.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Prevents selection and removes trigger from tab order.

props.name: invalid
props.notes: Applies error state when validation is owned by the consumer.

props.name: density
props.notes: Maps selector sizing to density context.

props.name: searchable
props.notes: Shows a local search field inside the option layer.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.notes: Placeholder for the local country/code search field.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.notes: Overrides trigger accessible name in composed contexts.

props.name: className
props.notes: Adds a consumer layout hook without changing anatomy.

props.name: hydrate
props.notes: Lets a parent component hydrate after composition.
